caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Nov 16–21 is here.

Time five sit-to-stands with your arms crossed, then retest every four weeks to track leg strength. Living with sciatica? Move the wallet to a front pocket and get out of the car or chair every 30 minutes. A pillow between your knees can make side sleeping easier on a sore back. And for massage, about 5–7 out of 10 pressure is usually plenty.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
